info.title: Safe-Fare Fleet BFF
info.description:
Safe-Fare Fleet backend-for-frontend. Valid status values, transitions and these conventions are also served by `GET /api/v1/reference/statuses`.

**Envelope.** Every response is `{code, msg, data, total, extend}`; `code` equals the HTTP status.

**Vendor data.** Vendor-backed reads report their source in `extend` (`source` VENDOR or LOCAL, `stale`, `fallbackReason`, `message`). When the vendor (GPSTrackTech) returns no data, `msg` and `extend.message` are **"No data from vendor"** and `extend.fallbackReason` is `VENDOR_EMPTY`. When stored data is served instead, `source` is LOCAL and `stale` is true.

**Errors.** `extend` is `{errorCode, fieldErrors[], requestId}`. `requestId` equals the `X-Request-Id` response header; send your own `X-Request-Id` to correlate. Status codes: 400 validation or invalid value, 401 missing or expired token, 403 missing permission, 404 not found (also for records of another tenant), 409 conflict or transition not allowed, 502/503/504 vendor or database problems, 500 unexpected.

**Times.** All instants are ISO-8601 UTC. Ranges are `[from, to)`: `from` inclusive, `to` exclusive; a missing `to` means now. Plain dates are UTC dates.

**Paging.** `pageNumber` starts at 1; `pageSize` 1-100 (default 20); `total` counts all matching records.

**Access.** Every record is scoped to the caller's tenant. Each operation lists its required permission. The Safe-Fare Admin (signs in without `tenantCode`) has no tenant of its own: send `?tenantId=<tenant id>` (or the `X-Tenant-Id` header) on create/update/delete operations (list tenants with `GET /api/v1/platform/tenants`), otherwise they answer 400 `TENANT_REQUIRED`; reads without it cover every tenant. Tenant users may omit it; any other tenant's id answers 403 `TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED`. `/api/v1/driver/**` also requires a user linked to a driver profile and only returns that driver's data.
